title: TestAtlas V2 Claim
description: A single claim extracted from a council transcript or persona output. PRD §7.10 / §11.1. Each claim is attributable to a speaker, links to evidence, and carries explicit epistemic status (type, confidence, status).

session_id.description: ID of the council session that produced this claim, e.g. COUNCIL-2026-05-03-001. May be empty for claims extracted outside a council.

speaker.description: Persona ID or actor that made the claim.

type.description: Epistemic class of the claim. See vocabulary.json claim_type.

claim.description: The claim itself, in plain English.

confidence.description: Confidence in the claim. V2 uses snake_case (V1 used kebab-case).

evidence.description: Evidence references (file paths, EVIDENCE-NNN ids, URLs).
